name: Hoshea
bio:
Hoshea son of Elah conspired against Pekah, king of Israel, struck him down, killed him, and took the throne for himself in the twentieth year of Jotham son of Uzziah (2 Kings 15:30).

## 📖 Core Story: The End of the Northern Kingdom

Hoshea reigned nine years, doing evil in the LORD's eyes, though not as badly as the kings before him. Shalmaneser, king of Assyria, made him a vassal paying tribute, but Hoshea conspired against Assyria by sending messengers to So, king of Egypt, and withholding his usual tribute. Shalmaneser imprisoned Hoshea and besieged Samaria for three years. In the ninth year, Assyria captured the city and deported Israel to Assyria, settling them in Halah, Habor by the river Gozan, and the cities of the Medes — ending the kingdom of Israel for good, a judgment Scripture attributes to Israel's persistent idolatry, rejection of the covenant, and refusal to heed the prophets across generations (2 Kings 17:1-23). The king of Assyria then resettled the land with foreign peoples who became the Samaritans (2 Kings 17:24).
